<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/sessions/{sessionId}/events"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The log is IMMUTABLE and ordered by `seq`. Normal pagination is incremental: pass the previous response's `nextCursor` as `afterSeq`. `latest=true` does the opposite — it fetches the TAIL and ignores `afterSeq`, for a screen that opens at the end instead of reconstructing the whole session from the start (ADR 0021).
